title: Eddoboozi Okuva Mu Bunnya
intro: Olugero lw’obugumiikiriza n’okusaasira okw’Obwakatonda okutaliiko kkomo lubikkulwa mu Quran. Omubaka yasindikibwa mu kibuga ekinene, naye abantu baabwe ne bagaana okulabula era ne bagaana amazima. Mu kwetamwa, emmeeme eno yagenda — kyokka n’egezesebwa ennyanja eyali efuukuuse era n’emira mu buziba obusinga okuba obw’ekizikiza. Okuva mu lubuto lw’ekizikiza, okwegayirira okw’obwetoowaze kwasituka, era Omusaasizi ennyo n’addamu. Omwoyo guno ogwavaayo nga gukyusiddwa, abantu baayo gwe bandifuuse abakkiriza abasukka mu mitwalo kikumi y’ani?
clues: Nasindikibwa ng’omulabuzi mu kibuga ekinene abatuuze baakyo kye baali bavudde mu kkubo ery’okukkiriza.
Nayita abantu bange mu mazima enfunda n’enfunda, naye ne basekerera era ne bagaana obubaka bwange.
Nabavaako nga nnyiize nga tebannaba kukkirizibwa, ne njolekera ennyanja enzigule.
Omuyaga omunene gwasituka, era ne nsuula mu nnyanja — olwo ne nmira ddala ekitonde ekinene ennyo eky’omu nnyanja.

Mu layers z’ekizikiza — obuziba bw’ennyanja, olubuto lw’ekitonde, ne wansi w’ennyanja enzito — nnaleekaana nti: ‘Tewali katonda mulala okuggyako Ggwe; ekitiibwa kibeere ku Ggwe; Nze nnali omu ku baakola ebibi.’
Allah yannunula mu buziba, era bwe nakomawo, abantu bange abasukka mu mitwalo kikumi baali bakwatidde ddala amazima.

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
